column3: Launch Visual Studio; create a C# Windows Forms App (.NET Framework); add a Visual Basic Class Library (.NET Standard) to the same solution; add a project reference from the class library to the Windows Forms app; open NuGet Package Manager on the class library, install EasyPost.NetStandard; then filter to vulnerable packages and update each to its latest stable version in a loop until none remain; finally build the solution and verify 'Build succeeded'. NOTE: many selectors here are Visual Studio version / UI-language dependent (language-filter combos, .NET Standard framework item, project-reference checkbox, the 'Show vulnerable' control, and the vulnerable-package list probe) and are flagged in the Expected column as needing live tuning.

column16: Per spec: every vulnerable package must be cleared. find_control exits 1 (no match) when the list is empty - which we expect; if any real vulnerable row remains (exit 0) this step fails the test.
